title: Sunrise on the Reaping
author: Suzanne Collins
summary: A prequel to The Hunger Games set decades earlier, following a teenage Haymitch Abernathy as he is forced into the Games' second Quarter Quell. It shows how the Capitol's grip took shape.
readIf: you want a bleaker, character-focused return to Panem with the Games as the main event.
skipIf: you want a hopeful read, because the story is grim and its outcome is already shadowed by the original trilogy.

pairings.reason: The original story that this prequel feeds into, and the obvious place to start if you have not read it.
A quieter, more philosophical dystopia about a society that hides cruelty behind order.
Another young-adult dystopia in which teenagers are caught up in lethal, state-run systems.
